_doc: Single source of truth for dev/blind splits. See docs/PLAN.md section 3. Do not edit without logging the change in docs/BLIND_LOG.md.

events._note: Ferreira moved to dev on 2026-10-28 after the v1 blind run (see docs/BLIND_LOG.md); event blind = own recordings + PVS 7-9

pvs._note: PVS 7-9 = vehicle 3 / driver 3, never seen in dev; used for false events per hour in normal driving

changes.change: Ferreira blind -> dev; PVS 7-9 added as blind
changes.reason: v1 blind run showed event detection fails on an unseen sensor; diagnosing it requires a third sensor in dev. Ferreira results after this date are dev numbers, not blind.

changes.change: Grab safety dataset added; 20% of bookings sealed as blind by hash rule
changes.reason: 20k labelled trips for a learned trip-level risk model

grab._note: Locked 2026-10-28 before any Grab feature was loaded. Labels: official Grab AI for S.E.A. safety labels, verified identical (sha256 fe609ddd...) in two independent GitHub repos. 18 bookings with conflicting labels are dropped.
